references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.
input.referenceConsumption: agy receives all named image references; creatures always include original approved Covenant creature source; Grok wrapper consumes first identity image only, Covenant style block is textual

arguments.Prompt:
A 3x2 sprite animation sheet of a fantasy creature collapsing / defeated death animation, on an entirely solid uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Exactly 6 sequential animation frames arranged in a neat grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, with wide empty magenta margins and gutters between each frame. No grid lines, borders, frames, or text.

Creature appearance (matching reference-1 and reference-2): An animal-only raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature ('Mire Maw'). Four short splayed sturdy legs, heavy moss-green stone-like hide, broad round mouth, glowing luminous turquoise throat sac, subtle root tendrils hanging beneath, chunky artillery silhouette. Intact, stylized painted creature, lighter painterly values, sculpted shapes, smooth opaque painted volume, cool lighting from upper-left with subtle highlights, no realistic horror, no photoreal skin/fur, no gore or blood.

Perspective & Orientation: Consistent elevated 55-degree orthographic top-down / isometric angle, FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view (head and front surfaces facing diagonally toward the viewer and toward the right side of each cell). Consistent identical anatomical scale across all 6 cells, with the creature fitting comfortably within the center 60% of each cell, leaving generous magenta empty space around it.

Animation Sequence across the 6 frames (3 columns x 2 rows):
- Cell 1 (Row 1, Col 1): Ready alert stance, standing on four legs, front-right 3/4 view, luminous turquoise throat sac glowing gently.
- Cell 2 (Row 1, Col 2): Beginning to collapse, legs folding outward, body and chest sinking lower toward the ground.
- Cell 3 (Row 1, Col 3): Collapsing further, chest and belly almost resting on the ground, limbs splayed wide.
- Cell 4 (Row 2, Col 1): Creature begins tipping gently onto its side, losing balance, head tilting down.
- Cell 5 (Row 2, Col 2): Head, chest, and heavy belly fully hitting the ground, sprawled limp.
- Cell 6 (Row 2, Col 3): Fully collapsed and still, lying completely flat on its side on the ground, head resting limp on the ground, four legs relaxed and sprawled, throat sac dimmed, completely defeated resting pose.

Style: Hand-painted digital dark fantasy concept art, stylized painted game character animation sprite sheet. Isolated entirely against pure solid flat #FF00FF vivid magenta background.
arguments.toolSummary: Generate Mire Maw collapse animation sheet
